metaDescription: Cornish Rex vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Cornish Rex boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Cornish Rex social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Cornish Rex exposure.
Weight range 6-10 lb (2.7-4.5 kg) and grooming needs (Thin coat; needs warmth.) belong in the same Cornish Rex household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Cornish Rex is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Cornish Rex appointments.
After the Cornish Rex puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Cornish Rex shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Cornish Rex make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Cornish Rex antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Cornish Rex dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small cat.
Reset the Cornish Rex reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Cornish Rex core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Cornish Rex misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Cornish Rex health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Cornish Rex adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
